faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Research Associate position at IIT Kharagpur?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Research Associate position at IIT Kharagpur is 10th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies for the Research Associate post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Research Associate post at IIT Kharagpur.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Associate role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D./MD/MS/MDS or equivalent degree, or have 3 years of relevant experience after MVSc/M.Pharm/ME/M.Tech with a research paper in an SCI journal.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the Research Associate position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Research Associate position is 35 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Research Associate post?
faq.answer: The salary offered is up to Rs. 58,000 per month, depending on the candidate's qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for this recruitment. All categories are exempt from paying the application fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application mode for the Research Associate position?
faq.answer: Interested candidates can apply online through the official IIT Kharagpur website.

faq.question: Q8. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is IIT/SRIC/R/AHH/2026/101.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job or a project-based position?
faq.answer: This is a project-based recruitment for the Research Associate position.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: You can find the official notification and the apply online link in the "Important Links" section of this article.
